---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement for the BOSC Community Library
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement, needs-triage
assignees: ''
---

## Problem Statement

Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe it clearly.
Example: "It is difficult to find resources in Swahili because..."

## Proposed Solution

Describe the feature or enhancement you would like to see.

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches have you considered? Why is your proposed solution better?

## Implementation Notes

Any technical details, file locations, or implementation hints that would help.

## Impact

Who benefits from this feature? (e.g., students in East Africa, French-speaking contributors)

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues and this is not a duplicate
- [ ] This aligns with the project's open educational mission
